facts.text: NEAR Shoemaker Spacecraft was deployed at Asteroid 433 Eros (South Pole) during NEAR Shoemaker at Eros in 2001.

Octagonal spacecraft bus measuring 1.5 x 1.7 meters with four gallium arsenide solar panels and a 1.5-meter high-gain antenna dish. Rested upright on Eros after an improvised gentle landing on February 12, 2001.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the deep-space environment.
Confirmed that Eros is a consolidated chunk of primitive ordinary chondrite material with a density of 2.67 g/cm³, nearly identical to Earth's continental crust.
Status: Silent and dormant in deep space.
A permanent human and robotic monument celebrating space exploration in deep space.
